newsitem.title: USA: Rubin says inflation to remain at "quite low rate".
newsitem.headline: Rubin says inflation to remain at "quite low rate".

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said evidence continues to suggest that inflation in the U.S. will remain at under control.
"Everything that I can see suggests that inflation is very likely to remain ... at a quite low rate," Rubin told reporters here on Wednesday.
As for the two open positions at the Federal Reserve Board of Governors, the Treasury Secretary said the Clinton administration is close to selecting its candidates.
"I think we are quite close to having a decision and I hope we will have an announcement fairly soon," he said.
There are two vacancies at the Fed Board. Janet Yellen left to become Chairwoman of the Council of Economic Advisers, while Lawrence Lindsey is joining the American Enterprise Institute.
